title: docsrs-cli get-item success data
description: Payload under envelope.data for command get-item. Outer envelope always has schema_version=1, ok, command, duration_ms. Optional fields are omitted when absent (never JSON null).

resolved_version.description: Omitted when docs.rs did not resolve a concrete version (never JSON null)

cache_hit.description: True when the HTTP response body was served from the local disk cache

extraction.description: Present for associated-method fetches: method-scoped markdown vs full parent item page fallback. Omitted for non-method items (never JSON null).
